main_text.p: Liberi quoq;, qui in adoptiva familia sunt ad naturalium parentum hæreditatem hoc eodem gradu vocantur.§.liberi quoq;.inst.cod.
Vulgò quæsitos, nullos habere agnatos, manifestum est: quum agnatio à patre fit, cognatio à matre: hi autem nullum patrem habere intelliguntur.§.vulgò.inst.cod.
main_text.head: QUIS EST SEXTUS Titulus? De gradibus cognationum. Von den graden der Sipschafft/ oder blut-freundtschafft.
main_text.p: IN primis admonendi sumus, cognationem aliam supra numerari, aliam infra, aliam ex transverso, quæ etiam a latere dicitur. Superior cognatio est parentum, Inferior liberorum, Ex transverso fratrum sororumve & eorum, qui quæve ex his generantur. in princip.cod.

head.i: Quot gradus numerantur in hoc titulo?

main_text.p: Sex: primo gradu est supra, pater, mater, im[?] ersten grad oberfich ist Vatter / Mutter: Infra filius, filia, underfich/Sohn/Tochter.
Secundo gradu supra avus, avia, grofvatter grof-muter: Infra, nepos, neptis, findes[?] john/findes tochter: Ex transverso frater, soror, bruder/schwester.

Tertio gradu supra proavus, proavia, der ander grosvatter / die ander grosmutter: Infra proneps, proneptis, ander findes john / ander findes tochter: Ex transverso fratris sororisq; filius, filia, & convenienter

page.notes: Fraktur passages are set in black letter and transcribed as printed; "im" in "im ersten" and the word "findes" are doubtful. "grof-muter" carries a line-end hyphen that is hard to read; the hyphen is taken from the scan. The italic status of some Latin phrases in the first paragraphs is uncertain and has been set in roman. The last line "nienter" completes the word "convenienter" from the line above; the sentence continues beyond this page's text.
